items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: So Jackson took a cab from New Joseph's cab

ctx.x: all of them stopped you from going, so you stayed, huh?

I came back to pick up my drums, Milt, and they had given me two quarts of whiskey and I went over to the rooming house and the guitar player and Basie was there. I gave them this two quarts of whiskey and I said, "I'm picking up my drums because I'm going back to school. I won't be playing in no band." And Ben Webster When Lester wanted to slap me. "Why, are you crazy?" And Herschel Evans says, "You're crazy. You can play in the band." I said, "No I can't." So I said, "All right, Mr. Basie, I will play with you…
